identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of SHR-1501 Combination With BCG Versus Placebo Combined With BCG in Subjects With Papillary-Only NMIBC
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind Phase III Study of Intravesical SHR-1501 Combined With Bacillus Calmette Guerin (BCG) Versus Placebo Combined With BCG In Patients With High-risk BCG-naive Papillary-Only Non-muscle-invasive Bladder Cancer (NMIBC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a multicenter, randomized, Double-blind phase III study to determine the efficacy and safety of intravesical SHR-1501 combined with Bacillus Calmette Guerin (BCG) versus Placebo Combined with BCG in patients with high-risk BCG-naive Papillary-Only non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC)

primaryOutcomes.measure: Disease-Free Survival (DFS) assessed by BICR: Disease-free survival is defined as the time from randomization to date of DFS event assessed by BICR.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Disease-Free Survival (DFS) assessed by investigator: Disease-free survival is defined as the time from randomization to date of DFS event assessed by investigator.
Overall Survival (OS): Overall Survival defined as the time from randomization to the date of death from any cause.
Number of adverse events (AEs) as assessed by CTCAE v6.0.
Number of serious adverse events (SAEs) as assessed by CTCAE v6.0.

locations.facility: The First Medical Center of the Chinese People's Liberation Army General Hospital
